reviewed_by: Claude Code, at the operator's request: remove the restart-recovery concurrency cap
reason: Live Core: after a worker crash, 44 turns were auto-resumed in one project, and a hardcoded per-worker semaphore of 2 (_AUTOMATIC_RECOVERY_CONCURRENCY), held for each turn's whole lifetime, serialized them behind two multi-hour subagents while provider capacity (60/58) sat mostly free. The semaphore is removed; recovered turns use ordinary provider admission and, although they resume in a running status, now wait out host-load pressure like new queued turns (admit(automatic_recovery=True)). Selected: the admission cleanup suite holding the changed and new tests, restart recovery lifecycle, async recovery, host load and shutdown admission suites.
exclusions: No UI, settings, or API shape change, so no frontend, Playwright, settings-assistant or LAN Core run: the path only runs when an execution worker dies with durable provider turns, which a disposable LAN Core cannot produce through operator entry points; the new tests drive start_provider_turn(automatic_recovery=True) and ProviderScheduler.admit directly. Broader chat suites are not selected because only the recovery admission path changed.
